mechanism_explanation: Older respondents (who have high recall ~93% and low specificity ~30%) are down-weighted by CDC raking to match US Census proportions. Younger respondents (who have low recall ~31% and high specificity ~97%) are up-weighted. Consequently, population-weighted recall is lower (-5.5% in 2021, -3.2% in 2022) while weighted specificity is significantly higher (+7.9%).
